flavor: Not much left in the kit. Enough for one bad day.

flavor: Broken in over three states. They fit like a promise.

flavor: Dented. Older than you.

Tote Bag
flavor: Canvas, thirty-one years of bus routes. Currently holds: everything.

name: Reading Glasses
flavor: For the ledger and the fine print on cans. The apocalypse has fine print.

name: Bus Schedule
flavor: The 42, laminated. Ruth keeps it to remind the universe about punctuality.

name: Hard Candy
flavor: Butterscotch. Ruth doles them out like medals.

name: Spare Socks
flavor: Dry socks are civilization. Ruth has always known this.

name: Dead Phone
flavor: Cracked screen, 2% forever. Theo keeps it the way sailors kept compasses.

name: Hoodie
flavor: Smells like dorm laundry and rain. Armor, basically.

name: Energy Bar Wrapper
flavor: Empty. Theo reads the nutrition label when he misses numbers.

name: Notebook
flavor: Half speedrun notes, half apocalypse patch notes. Theo's magnum opus.

name: Stethoscope
flavor: Hear a heartbeat through anything. Useful for people. Useless for the System.

name: Bandana
flavor: Sling, bandage, filter, flag. The most versatile square of cloth ever made.

name: Protein bar
flavor: Tastes like cardboard. 200 kcal of cardboard.

name: Snare wire
flavor: Thin, strong, patient. The rabbit doesn't know it's there until it does.

name: Trail mix
flavor: Nuts, raisins, chocolate. The chocolate is gone. The hope remains.

name: Binoculars
flavor: See far. The far is mostly trees. But sometimes it's dinner.

name: Chopsticks
flavor: Not just for eating. For picking, probing, and pointing at things.

name: Soy packets
flavor: Six little packets. Salt is civilization.

name: Bus map
flavor: Every route she ever drove. None of them go here.

name: Phone charger
flavor: No phone, no outlet. But it's a really good cable.

name: Energy drink
flavor: 300mg of caffeine. For emergencies. Everything is an emergency.

name: Dice set
flavor: For when decisions need to be fast and blame needs to be random.

name: Calculator
flavor: The pantry math must be exact. Estimating is how pantries die.

name: Pen set
flavor: Blue, black, red. For writing, underlining, and correcting.

name: Tasting spoon
flavor: A chef tastes everything. Even the apocalypse.

name: Thermos
flavor: Keeps things hot. Hot is a memory now.

name: Photo album
flavor: Faces from before. The most valuable thing she owns.
